content: Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, tɔn kɔ̃so ɡoo wɑ̃ɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn bweseru sɔɔ, win yĩsirɑ Sebɑ, Bikirin bii. Yerɑ u kɔbɑ so u nɛɛ,

content.text: mbɑ n sun mɔɔsinɛ bɛsɛ kɑ Dɑfidi Isɑin bii.
Mɛyɑ sɑ ǹ mɑɑ tubi tiɑ dimɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, bɛɛ Isirelibɑ, bɑɑwure u wuro win yɛnuɔ.

content: Yerɑ Isireli be kpuro bɑ Dɑfidi deri bɑ Sebɑ swĩi. Adɑmɑ Yudɑbɑ bɑ kɑ Dɑfidi ben sinɑ boko yɔ̃rɑ. Mɑ bɑ nùn yɔ̃siri sɑɑ Yuudɛnin dɑɑrun di sere Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.

Dɑfidi u turɑ win yɛnuɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. U win kurɔbu wɔku te u rɑɑ deri bɑ yɛnu kɔ̃su suɑ u doke diru ɡɑru sɔɔ u nɔɔrimɔ. Adɑmɑ u ǹ kɑ bu kpunɑre. Diru miyɑ u bu kɛnusi bɑ wɑ̃ɑ nɡe ɡɔminibu sere bɑ rɑ kɑ ɡu.
Yoɑbu u Amɑsɑ ɡo
Yerɑ sinɑ boko u Amɑsɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, sere n kɑ ko sɔ̃ɔ itɑ nɑ kĩ ɑ mɑn Yudɑbɑ mɛnnɑ ɑ kɑ bu nɑ mini.
Mɑ Amɑsɑ wi, u dɑ u Yudɑ be kpuro mɛnnɑ. Adɑmɑ u tɛ n kere sɔ̃ɔ itɑ ye sinɑ boko u nùn burɑ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Abisɑi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Sebɑ, Bikirin bii, u koo sun kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ yɑ n Abusɑlɔmuɡiɑ kere. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ wunɛn yinnin tɑbu kowobu suo kpɑ i nùn nɑɑ swĩi, u sere kuke wuu ɡe ɡɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑru mɔ sɔɔ.
Mɑ Abisɑi u seewɑ kɑ Yoɑbun tɑbu kowobu kɑ Pelɛtibɑ kɑ Keretibɑ be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ sinɑ bokon kɔ̃sobu, kɑ sere mɑɑ tɑbu durɔ wɔruɡɔbɑ. Beyɑ bɑ yɑrɑ Yerusɑlɛmun di bɑ Sebɑ, Bikirin bii wi nɑɑ ɡirɑ.

Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ turɑ Gɑbɑonin kpee bɑkɑrɔ yerɑ bɑ kɑ Amɑsɑ yinnɑ. N deemɑ Yoɑbu u win tɑbu yɑ̃nu sebuɑ mɑ u win tɑkobin bɛkitiɑ sɛ̃kɑ pɔrɑɔ, mɑ yen tii yɑ sɑ̃ɑre. Ye u Amɑsɑ susimɔ, yerɑ tɑkobi ye, yɑ wɔrumɑ yen kɑrɑrun di.
Mɑ u Amɑsɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ bwɑ̃ɑ do nɛn wɔnɔku? Yen biru u win toburu nɛnuɑ u kɑ nùn bɔkɑsi.

N deemɑ Amɑsɑ kun tɑkobi yen lɑɑkɑri sɑ̃ɑ ye Yoɑbu u nɛni. Mɑ u nùn ye sɔkɑ nɔn teeru nukurɔ u nuki yɑrɑ. Mɑ Amɑsɑ u wɔrumɑ yɑnde u ɡu. Bɑ Sebɑ kɑmiɑ bɑ ɡo Yen biru Yoɑbu kɑ win wɔnɔ Abisɑi bɑ wure bɑ Sebɑ nɑɑ ɡirɑ.
Yerɑ Yoɑbun tɑbu durɔ turo u yɔ̃rɑ Amɑsɑn ɡoo ten bɔkuɔ u ɡerumɔ u mɔ̀, wi u Yoɑbu kɑ Dɑfidi kĩ, u Yoɑbu swĩiyɔ.
Mɑ Amɑsɑn ɡoo te, tɑ kpĩ tɑ yɛm mwɛɛre swɑɑ suunu sɔɔ. Ye tɑbu durɔ wi, u wɑ tɔmbɑ yɔ̃rɑmɔ mi, yerɑ u ɡoo te ɡɑwɑ swɑɑn di u kɑ dɑ yɑkɑsɔ u tu bekuru wukiri.
Ye u kpɑ, yerɑ tɔmbɑ sɑrɑ bɑ Yoɑbu swĩi bɑ kɑ Sebɑ Bikirin bii wi nɑɑ ɡirɑ.
Ye Yoɑbu u dɔɔ Abɛli Bɛti Mɑɑkɑn berɑ ɡiɑ, yerɑ u Isirelibɑn bwese kɛri kpuro bukiɑnɑ. Mɑ ben tɑbu durɔ wɔruɡɔbɑ bɑ nùn swĩi.
Ye bɑ tunumɑ Abɛli Bɛti Mɑɑkɑɔ bɑ deemɑ Sebɑ u wɑ̃ɑ mi, yerɑ bɑ ye tɑrusi. Bɑ yɑnim tɑkɑru kuɑ tɑ kɑ wuu ɡen ɡbɑ̃rɑru ɡunum nɛrɑ. Yen biru bɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ ten temɔ ɡbɑ bu kɑ tu surɑ.
Yerɑ wuu min tɔn kurɔ bwisiɡii ɡoo u nɔɔɡiru suɑ u nɛɛ, i swɑɑ dɑkio i nɔ. I mɑn Yoɑbu sokuɑmɑ n kɑ nùn ɡɑri ko.
Mɑ Yoɑbu u nùn susi. Yerɑ kurɔ wi, u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, wunɑ Yoɑbu? Mɑ u wisɑ u nɛɛ, oo, nɛnɑ. Kurɔ wi, u mɑɑ nɛɛ, ɑ nɛn ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑkio. Mɑ Yoɑbu u nɛɛ, ɑ ɡerumɑ.
Kurɔ wi, u nɛɛ, yellu bɑ rɑ rɑɑ nɛɛwɑ, ɑ bikiɑru doo Abɛli Bɛti Mɑɑkɑɔ kpɑ n nùn kuɑ nɡe mɛ ɑ kĩ.

Bɛsɛn wuu ɡeni, ɡɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wuu si su bɔri yɛndu mɔn teu kɑ si su rɑ Isirelibɑn woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɛn teu, n kere wuu si su tie. Adɑmɑ wunɛ, ɑ kɑsu ɑ ɡu ɡo, ɡe, ɡe ɡɑ sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn wuu mɑrosun teu. Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ kɑsu ɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɑrumɑni kpeerɑsiɑ.
Mɑ Yoɑbu u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, su ku wɑ mɛ, bu nɛɛ, nɛnɑ nɑ wuu ɡe kpeerɑsiɑ nɑ ɡen dukiɑ ɡurɑ.

N ǹ mɛ nɛn bwisikunu. Efɑrɑimu wi bɑ mɔ̀ Sebɑ, Bikirin biiwɑ u Dɑfidi seesi. Wiyɑ sɑ kɑsu. Yen sɔ̃, i nùn yɑrɑmɑ i sun nɔmu sɔndiɑ, kpɑ n doonɑ n wuu ɡe deri. Mɑ kurɔ wi, u Yoɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, sɑ ko nun win wiru kɑsɑ kuɑmɑ.

Mɑ kurɔ wi, u dɑ u tɔmbu mɛnnɑ kɑ bwisi bɑ dɑ Sebɑn mi, bɑ win wiru burɑ bɑ tu Yoɑbu kɑsɑ kuɑmɑ. Yerɑ Yoɑbu u kɔbɑ so mɑ win tɑbu kowobu bɑ yɑrinɑ bɑ wuu ɡe deri. Ben bɑɑwure u wurɑ win yɛnuɔ. Mɑ Yoɑbun tii u ɡɔsirɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ u dɑ sinɑ bokon mi.
Dɑfidin sɔm kowobu

Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Dɑfidi sinɑ bokon sɔm kowobu, ben yĩsɑ wee. Yoɑbuwɑ Dɑfidi u kuɑ Isirelibɑ kpuron tɑbu sunɔ. Bɛnɑyɑ, Yehoyɑdɑn bii, wiyɑ u mɑɑ Keretibɑ kɑ Pelɛtibɑ kpɑre be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Dɑfidin tiin kɔ̃sobu.
Adorɑmuwɑ u rɑ mɑɑ tɔmbu wɔ̃ɔ ɡobi mwɑɑri. Yosɑfɑti, Ahiludun biiwɑ u rɑ mɑɑ tirenu bere.
Seyɑwɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ tire yoro. Mɑ Sɑdɔku kɑ Abiɑtɑɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu.
Irɑ, Yɑiriɡiiwɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Dɑfidin sinɑ kpɑɑrun wiruɡii turo.
Bɑ Sɔɔlun bweseru ɡo
